name: Radiowalla Network Ltd
about: Incorporated in July 2010, Radiowalla Network Ltd is a premicr provider of in-store radio and Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) advertising solutions[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RNL is an in-store radio company. It has collaboration with 500+ retailers across 10 countries with 1 Billion Listener and 100+ Advt Campaigns

pros: Debtor days have improved from 92.4 to 72.3 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.68 Cr.
